description: This file defines constants, data structures, and function prototypes for phase dispersion processing in an AMR speech codec, including external variable declarations and state management functions.

methods.name: ph_disp_reset
methods.description: Initializes the phase dispersion state memory.

methods.name: ph_disp_exit
methods.description: Frees memory used for phase dispersion state.

methods.name: ph_disp_lock
methods.description: Locks phase dispersion in the state structure.

methods.name: ph_disp_release
methods.description: Releases (unlocks) phase dispersion in the state structure.

methods.name: ph_disp
methods.description: Performs phase dispersion based on codec mode and computes total excitation for synthesis.
